document.about: Seagate Exos X16 hard drive data sheet (3 pages). The cover sets a 12.7 pt tagline over the 20.2 pt product name, and the back page sets the site name at 10.5 pt above 6 pt legal text.

notes: #230: once the data sheet's body read as regular, its drawn-bullet items were parted as entries set one per line: the list is set narrower than its column, so each first line ends well short of the column's edge, and the wrapped line opens with a name.
